patterns.search_text:
Cache dependency downloads

Pattern: P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency_cache)

When is cache dependency downloads applicable?

Assess cache dependency downloads for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Repeated dependency fetching is measurable; Cache inputs include lockfile and environment

Contraindications: Mutable or untrusted cached content; An equivalent cache already exists

Method: Choose dependency download state rather than unchecked build outputs; Keep installation and all required tests

Reported finding: Caching has modest aggregate benefit.

Reported metrics: {"vm_time_reduction_percent": {"free": 6, "paid": 3.4}}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.1; Table 4; PDF pp. 6, 7: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

install dependencies
run required checks

name: ESLint

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: 16

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-npm-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npx eslint .

before.content:
name: ESLint

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: 16

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npx eslint .

diff.content:
--- a/.github/workflows/eslint.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/eslint.yml
@@ -17,6 +17,11 @@
         with:
           node-version: 16
 
+      - uses: actions/cache@v4
+        with:
+          path: ~/.npm
+          key: ${{ runner.os }}-npm-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
+
       - name: Install Dependencies
         run: npm ci

The original checkout, setup, npm ci, and ESLint commands remain unchanged, so required checks and install/test behavior are preserved.

      - run: bandit --recursive --skip B404,B602,B605 .

                    --max-complexity=32 --max-line-length=118 --show-source --statistics .
      - run: isort --check-only --profile black . || true
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: mkdir --parents --verbose .mypy_cache
      - run: mypy --ignore-missing-imports --install-types --non-interactive . || true
      - run: pytest . || pytest --doctest-modules . || true
      - run: shopt -s globstar && pyupgrade --py36-plus **/*.py || true
      - run: safety check

      - name: Append Path

      - name: Cache Arduino CLI dependencies

          # prepare config

          arduino-cli config add board_manager.additional_urls https://arduino.esp8266.com/stable/package_esp8266com_index.json
          arduino-cli config add board_manager.additional_urls https://raw.githubusercontent.com/espressif/arduino-esp32/gh-pages/package_esp32_index.json

          # install
          make install

          # link library
          mkdir -p ~/Arduino/libraries
          ln -s $PWD ~/Arduino/libraries/.

Pattern: P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW (workflow_skip)

When is skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs applicable?

Assess skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Reported finding: Explicit skipping has limited aggregate impact.

Bound jobs with a custom timeout

Pattern: P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (job_timeout)

When is bound jobs with a custom timeout applicable?

Assess bound jobs with a custom timeout for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Representative successful-duration history exists

Contraindications: Valid slow runs exceed the proposed limit

Method: Choose an explicit budget with operational headroom; Measure false timeout failures separately

Reported finding: Custom timeouts reduce runaway consumption.

Reported metrics: {"vm_time_reduction_percent": {"free": 12.9, "paid": 8.1}}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.6; Table 4; PDF pp. 7, 8: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

name: PHP Composer

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Validate composer.json and composer.lock
      run: composer validate --strict

    - name: Cache Composer packages
      id: composer-cache
      uses: actions/cache@v3
      with:
        path: vendor
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-php-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-php-

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress

    - name: Run linter
      run: composer run-script lint

    - name: Run tests
      run: composer run-script tests

def schedule_failures(data, settings):
    failures, paused, trace, notifications\
        \ = 0, False, [], []
    for row in data:
        if row["kind"] == "\
        owner_reset":
            failures, paused = 0, False
            trace.append({"\
        id": row["id"], "action": "owner_reset"})
            continue
 \
        \       if paused:
            trace.append({"id": row["id"], "action"\
        : "suppressed"})
            continue
        trace.append({**row, "\
        action": "run"})
        failures = failures + 1 if row["outcome"] ==\
        \ "failure" else 0
        if settings["pause_after_failures"] and failures\
        \ >= settings["pause_after_failures"]:
            paused = True
    \
        \        if settings["notify_on_pause"]:
                notifications.append({"\
        after_event": row["id"], "recipient": "synthetic_owner"})
    return\
        \ {"trace": trace, "notifications": notifications,
            "simulated_work_seconds"\
        : sum(r.get("duration", 0) for r in trace if r["action"] == "run")}

def schedule_idle(data, settings):

        \ []

        ]:

    \

        : row["kind"], "version": version})

    \
        \    trace.append({**row, "version": version, "action": "run" if run\
        \ else "suppressed"})

  \
        \  return {"trace": trace, "simulated_work_seconds": sum(r.get("duration"\
        , 0) for r in trace if r["action"] == "run")}


def order_jobs(data,\
        \ settings):
    jobs = data["jobs"]

        ])
    while True:
        expanded = preferred | {dep for job in jobs if\
        \ job["id"] in preferred for dep in job["needs"]}
        if expanded\
        \ == preferred:
            break
        preferred = expanded
    cases\
        \ = []
    for case in data["cases"]:
        done, trace, clock, feedback\
        \ = {}, [], 0, None
        while len(done) < len(jobs):
            ready\
        \ = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in done and all(dep in done for\
        \ dep in job["needs"])]
            if not ready:
                raise\
        \ ValueError("Invalid replay dependency graph")
            if settings["\
        order"] == "previous_failure_ancestors_first":
                ready.sort(key=lambda\
        \ job: job["id"] not in preferred)
            job = ready[0]
       \
        \     skipped = any(done[dep] != "success" for dep in job["needs"])
\
        \            status = "skipped" if skipped else "failure" if job["id"\
        ] == case["failure"] else "success"
            started = clock
   \
        \         clock += 0 if skipped else job["duration"]

        \ == "failure" and feedback is None:

        \            done[job["id"]] = status

        : job["id"], "needs": job["needs"], "start": started, "end": clock,\
        \ "outcome": status})
        cases.append({"id": case["id"], "trace"\

    return {"cases": cases, "simulated_work_seconds": sum(c["\

        \ = 0, False, [], []

        owner_reset":

        \ >= settings["pause_after_failures"]:

    \
        \        if settings["notify_on_pause"]:

        after_event": row["id"], "recipient": "synthetic_owner"})

        \ {"trace": trace, "notifications": notifications,

def schedule_idle(data, settings):

        , 0) for r in trace if r["action"] == "run")}

        \ settings):

        \ dep in job["needs"])]
            if not ready:

            if settings["\
        order"] == "previous_failure_ancestors_first":

        \ job: job["id"] not in preferred)

       \
        \     skipped = any(done[dep] != "success" for dep in job["needs"])
\
        \            status = "skipped" if skipped else "failure" if job["id"\
        ] == case["failure"] else "success"

\

Pattern: P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE (scheduled_run_reduction)

When is suppress schedules during repository inactivity applicable?

Assess suppress schedules during repository inactivity for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

'on':

jobs:
  probe:
    name: probe
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
    - name: Controlled workload
      shell: bash
      run: "python3 - <<'CLOUDTUNE_REPLAY_ENGINE'
"""Deterministic service-policy\
        \ replays, also executed inside the hosted CI fixture.

All times and outcomes\
        \ here are synthetic. They are never repository speedups.
Only previously\
        \ observed outcomes are exposed to a scheduling/selection policy.
"""
\
        import json
import os
import statistics


PATTERNS = {
    "P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE"\
        , "P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE", "P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST",
    "P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY"\
        , "P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT", "P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION",
}


def policy(pattern,\
        \ optimized=False):
    values = {
        "P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE": {"\
        pause_after_failures": 2 if optimized else 0,
                         \
        \       "notify_on_pause": optimized, "recovery": "explicit_owner_reset"\
        },
        "P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE": {"suppress_unchanged_inputs": optimized,
\
        \                                "meaningful_inputs": ["user_source",\
        \ "external_dependency"]},
        "P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST": {"order"\
        : "previous_failure_ancestors_first" if optimized else "declared",
 \
        \                                   "cancel_other_jobs": False},
     \
        \   "P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY": {"order": "priority_with_aging" if optimized\
        \ else "fifo", "max_wait": 12},
        "P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT": {"skip_docs_after_observed_success"\
        : optimized,
                               "always_build": ["source"\
        , "lockfile", "setup"]},
        "P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION": {"predictor"\
        : "past_feature_mean" if optimized else "past_global_mean",
        \
        \                             "initial_estimate": 20, "train_count": 6},
\
        \    }
    return values[pattern]


def dataset(pattern, repeat):
  \
        \  """Three reproducible workloads; repeat changes durations, never visibility\
        \ rules."""
    if repeat not in (1, 2, 3):
        raise ValueError("\
        Replay repeat must be 1, 2 or 3")
    scale = repeat
    if pattern ==\
        \ "P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE":
        return [{"id": i, "kind": kind, "\
        outcome": outcome, "duration": 5 * scale}
                for i, (kind,\
        \ outcome) in enumerate([
                    ("scheduled", "failure"\
        ), ("scheduled", "failure"), ("scheduled", "failure"),
         \
        \           ("scheduled", "failure"), ("owner_reset", None), ("scheduled"\
        , "success"),
                    ("scheduled", "failure"), ("scheduled"\
        , "success"),
                    ("scheduled", "failure"), ("scheduled"\
        , "success")])]
    if pattern == "P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE":
        return\
        \ [{"id": i, "kind": kind, "duration": 5 * scale} for i, kind in enumerate([
\
        \            "tick", "tick", "generated_commit", "tick", "external_dependency"\
        , "tick",
            "tick", "user_source", "tick", "tick"])]
\
        \    if pattern == "P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST":
        jobs = [{"id": "\
        lint", "needs": [], "duration": 30 * scale},
                {"id"\
        : "compile", "needs": [], "duration": 10 * scale},
               \
        \ {"id": "test", "needs": ["compile"], "duration": 5 * scale},
\
        \                {"id": "package", "needs": ["test"], "duration"\
        : 3 * scale}]
        return {"previous_failures": ["test"], "jobs"\
        : jobs,
                "cases": [{"id": "fails_again", "failure"\
        : "test"},
                          {"id": "recovered", "failure"\
        : None},
                          {"id": "artifact_dependency", "failure"\
        : None}]}
    if pattern == "P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY":
        return {"\
        no_contention": [{"id": "a", "arrival": 0, "duration": 2, "priority"\
        : 1},

        \ "duration": 2, "priority": 5}],

        id": "blocker", "arrival": 0, "duration": 8, "priority": 0},
  \

        : 6, "priority": 0},

        , "arrival": 1, "duration": 6, "priority": 0},
                   \
        \           {"id": "urgent", "arrival": 2, "duration": 1, "priority"\
        : 10},
                              *[{"id": "new-" + str(i), "arrival"\
        : 9 + i, "duration": 3, "priority": 9}
                             \
        \   for i in range(6)]]}
    if pattern == "P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT":
    \
        \    return [{"id": i, "change": change, "outcome": outcome, "duration"\
        : 5 * scale,
                 "failure_cause": "external_setup_failure"\
        \ if i == 2 else "build_failure" if outcome == "failure" else None}
\
        \                for i, (change, outcome) in enumerate([
               \
        \     ("source", "success"), ("docs", "success"), ("docs", "failure"\
        ),
                    ("lockfile", "failure"), ("docs", "success"\

        :

        \ * scale}

  \

        large", 92),

        , 12), ("large", 93),
                    ("small", 10), ("large",\
        \ 90)])]
    raise ValueError("Unsupported replay pattern: " + pattern)
\
        

def schedule_failures(data, settings):
    failures, paused, trace, notifications\
        \ = 0, False, [], []
    for row in data:
        if row["kind"] == "\
        owner_reset":
            failures, paused = 0, False
            trace.append({"\
        id": row["id"], "action": "owner_reset"})
            continue
 \
        \       if paused:
            trace.append({"id": row["id"], "action"\
        : "suppressed"})
            continue
        trace.append({**row, "\
        action": "run"})
        failures = failures + 1 if row["outcome"] ==\
        \ "failure" else 0
        if settings["pause_after_failures"] and failures\
        \ >= settings["pause_after_failures"]:
            paused = True
    \
        \        if settings["notify_on_pause"]:
                notifications.append({"\
        after_event": row["id"], "recipient": "synthetic_owner"})
    return\
        \ {"trace": trace, "notifications": notifications,
            "simulated_work_seconds"\
        : sum(r.get("duration", 0) for r in trace if r["action"] == "run")}
\
        

def schedule_idle(data, settings):
    version, built, trace = 0, None,\
        \ []
    for row in data:
        if row["kind"] in settings["meaningful_inputs"\
        ]:
            version += 1
        if row["kind"] != "tick":
    \
        \        trace.append({"id": row["id"], "action": "input", "kind"\
        : row["kind"], "version": version})
            continue
        run\
        \ = not settings["suppress_unchanged_inputs"] or built != version
    \
        \    trace.append({**row, "version": version, "action": "run" if run\
        \ else "suppressed"})
        if run:
            built = version
  \
        \  return {"trace": trace, "simulated_work_seconds": sum(r.get("duration"\
        , 0) for r in trace if r["action"] == "run")}


def order_jobs(data,\
        \ settings):
    jobs = data["jobs"]
    preferred = set(data["previous_failures"\
        ])
    while True:
        expanded = preferred | {dep for job in jobs if\
        \ job["id"] in preferred for dep in job["needs"]}
        if expanded\
        \ == preferred:
            break
        preferred = expanded
    cases\
        \ = []
    for case in data["cases"]:
        done, trace, clock, feedback\
        \ = {}, [], 0, None
        while len(done) < len(jobs):
            ready\
        \ = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in done and all(dep in done for\
        \ dep in job["needs"])]
            if not ready:
                raise\
        \ ValueError("Invalid replay dependency graph")
            if settings["\
        order"] == "previous_failure_ancestors_first":
                ready.sort(key=lambda\
        \ job: job["id"] not in preferred)
            job = ready[0]
       \
        \     skipped = any(done[dep] != "success" for dep in job["needs"])
\
        \            status = "skipped" if skipped else "failure" if job["id"\
        ] == case["failure"] else "success"
            started = clock
   \
        \         clock += 0 if skipped else job["duration"]
            if status\
        \ == "failure" and feedback is None:
                feedback = clock
\
        \            done[job["id"]] = status
            trace.append({"id"\
        : job["id"], "needs": job["needs"], "start": started, "end": clock,\
        \ "outcome": status})
        cases.append({"id": case["id"], "trace"\
        : trace, "first_failure_seconds": feedback,
                      "simulated_work_seconds"\
        : clock})
    return {"cases": cases, "simulated_work_seconds": sum(c["\
        simulated_work_seconds"] for c in cases)}


def queue_builds(data, settings):
\
        \    cases = {}
    for name, rows in data.items():
        pending, trace,\
        \ clock = list(rows), [], 0
        while pending:
            clock = max(clock,\
        \ min(row["arrival"] for row in pending))
            ready = [row for\
        \ row in pending if row["arrival"] <= clock]
            aged = [row for\
        \ row in ready if clock - row["arrival"] >= settings["max_wait"]]
  \
        \          reason = "fifo"
            if settings["order"] == "priority_with_aging"\
        :
                ready = aged if aged else ready
                reason\
        \ = "aging" if aged else "priority"
                ready.sort(key=lambda\
        \ row: (row["arrival"], rows.index(row)) if aged else
                \
        \           (-row["priority"], row["arrival"], rows.index(row)))
   \
        \         else:
                ready.sort(key=lambda row: (row["arrival"\
        ], rows.index(row)))
            row = ready[0]
            trace.append({**row,\
        \ "start": clock, "wait": clock - row["arrival"], "reason": reason})
\
        \            clock += row["duration"]
            pending.remove(row)
\
        \        cases[name] = {"trace": trace, "max_wait_seconds": max(row["\
        wait"] for row in trace),
                       "urgent_wait_seconds"\
        : next((row["wait"] for row in trace if row["id"] == "urgent"), None)}
\

patterns.search_text:
Run previously failing jobs first

Pattern: P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST (history_based_job_gating)

When is run previously failing jobs first applicable?

Assess run previously failing jobs first for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Required dependencies allow reordering; Policy permits stopping after an earlier failure

Contraindications: Independent outcomes must all be collected; Adding a gate would hide required results

Method: Separate early feedback from cancellation-based savings; Preserve the dependency graph

Reported finding: Failure-first gating saves work on failures.

Reported metrics: {"paid_failed_run_vm_time_reduction_percent": 31.6, "paid_total_vm_time_reduction_percent": 1.1}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.3.3; Table 5; PDF pp. 8, 9: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

name: CloudTune controlled scenario
'on':
  push:
    branches:
    - ct-scenario/**
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  probe:
    name: probe
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
    - name: Controlled workload
      shell: bash
      run: "python3 - <<'CLOUDTUNE_REPLAY_ENGINE'
"""Deterministic service-policy\
        \ replays, also executed inside the hosted CI fixture.

All times and outcomes\
        \ here are synthetic. They are never repository speedups.
Only previously\
        \ observed outcomes are exposed to a scheduling/selection policy.
"""
\
        import json
import os
import statistics


PATTERNS = {
    "P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE"\
        , "P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE", "P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST",
    "P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY"\
        , "P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT", "P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION",
}


def policy(pattern,\
        \ optimized=False):
    values = {
        "P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE": {"\
        pause_after_failures": 2 if optimized else 0,
                         \

def order_jobs(data,\
        \ settings):
    jobs = data["jobs"]

        ])
    while True:
        expanded = preferred | {dep for job in jobs if\
        \ job["id"] in preferred for dep in job["needs"]}
        if expanded\
        \ == preferred:
            break
        preferred = expanded
    cases\
        \ = []
    for case in data["cases"]:
        done, trace, clock, feedback\
        \ = {}, [], 0, None
        while len(done) < len(jobs):
            ready\

        \ dep in job["needs"])]
            if not ready:
                raise\
        \ ValueError("Invalid replay dependency graph")
            if settings["\
        order"] == "previous_failure_ancestors_first":
                ready.sort(key=lambda\
        \ job: job["id"] not in preferred)
            job = ready[0]
       \

\
        \            status = "skipped" if skipped else "failure" if job["id"\
        ] == case["failure"] else "success"
            started = clock
   \
        \         clock += 0 if skipped else job["duration"]
            if status\
        \ == "failure" and feedback is None:

\
        \            done[job["id"]] = status
            trace.append({"id"\
        : job["id"], "needs": job["needs"], "start": started, "end": clock,\
        \ "outcome": status})
        cases.append({"id": case["id"], "trace"\
        : trace, "first_failure_seconds": feedback,
                      "simulated_work_seconds"\
        : clock})
    return {"cases": cases, "simulated_work_seconds": sum(c["\

def schedule_failures(data, settings):

        \ = 0, False, [], []

        owner_reset":

        : "suppressed"})

        action": "run"})

        \ "failure" else 0

        \ >= settings["pause_after_failures"]:
            paused = True
    \
        \        if settings["notify_on_pause"]:

        after_event": row["id"], "recipient": "synthetic_owner"})

        \ {"trace": trace, "notifications": notifications,

def schedule_idle(data, settings):

        , 0) for r in trace if r["action"] == "run")}

            if settings["\
        order"] == "previous_failure_ancestors_first":

\
        \            status = "skipped" if skipped else "failure" if job["id"\
        ] == case["failure"] else "success"

\

def policy(pattern,\
        \ optimized=False):
    values = {
        "P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE": {"\
        pause_after_failures": 2 if optimized else 0,
                         \
        \       "notify_on_pause": optimized, "recovery": "explicit_owner_reset"\
        },
        "P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE": {"suppress_unchanged_inputs": optimized,
\
        \                                "meaningful_inputs": ["user_source",\
        \ "external_dependency"]},
        "P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST": {"order"\
        : "previous_failure_ancestors_first" if optimized else "declared",
 \
        \                                   "cancel_other_jobs": False},
     \
        \   "P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY": {"order": "priority_with_aging" if optimized\
        \ else "fifo", "max_wait": 12},
        "P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT": {"skip_docs_after_observed_success"\
        : optimized,
                               "always_build": ["source"\
        , "lockfile", "setup"]},
        "P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION": {"predictor"\
        : "past_feature_mean" if optimized else "past_global_mean",
        \
        \                             "initial_estimate": 20, "train_count": 6},
\
        \    }
    return values[pattern]


def dataset(pattern, repeat):
  \
        \  """Three reproducible workloads; repeat changes durations, never visibility\
        \ rules."""
    if repeat not in (1, 2, 3):
        raise ValueError("\
        Replay repeat must be 1, 2 or 3")
    scale = repeat
    if pattern ==\
        \ "P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE":
        return [{"id": i, "kind": kind, "\
        outcome": outcome, "duration": 5 * scale}
                for i, (kind,\
        \ outcome) in enumerate([
                    ("scheduled", "failure"\
        ), ("scheduled", "failure"), ("scheduled", "failure"),
         \
        \           ("scheduled", "failure"), ("owner_reset", None), ("scheduled"\
        , "success"),
                    ("scheduled", "failure"), ("scheduled"\
        , "success"),
                    ("scheduled", "failure"), ("scheduled"\
        , "success")])]
    if pattern == "P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE":
        return\
        \ [{"id": i, "kind": kind, "duration": 5 * scale} for i, kind in enumerate([
\
        \            "tick", "tick", "generated_commit", "tick", "external_dependency"\
        , "tick",
            "tick", "user_source", "tick", "tick"])]
\
        \    if pattern == "P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST":

        lint", "needs": [], "duration": 30 * scale},

        : "compile", "needs": [], "duration": 10 * scale},

        \ {"id": "test", "needs": ["compile"], "duration": 5 * scale},
\
        \                {"id": "package", "needs": ["test"], "duration"\
        : 3 * scale}]

def schedule_failures(data, settings):
    failures, paused, trace, notifications\
        \ = 0, False, [], []
    for row in data:
        if row["kind"] == "\
        owner_reset":
            failures, paused = 0, False
            trace.append({"\
        id": row["id"], "action": "owner_reset"})
            continue
 \
        \       if paused:
            trace.append({"id": row["id"], "action"\
        : "suppressed"})
            continue
        trace.append({**row, "\
        action": "run"})
        failures = failures + 1 if row["outcome"] ==\
        \ "failure" else 0
        if settings["pause_after_failures"] and failures\
        \ >= settings["pause_after_failures"]:
            paused = True
    \
        \        if settings["notify_on_pause"]:
                notifications.append({"\
        after_event": row["id"], "recipient": "synthetic_owner"})
    return\
        \ {"trace": trace, "notifications": notifications,
            "simulated_work_seconds"\
        : sum(r.get("duration", 0) for r in trace if r["action"] == "run")}
\
        

def schedule_idle(data, settings):
    version, built, trace = 0, None,\
        \ []
    for row in data:
        if row["kind"] in settings["meaningful_inputs"\
        ]:
            version += 1
        if row["kind"] != "tick":
    \
        \        trace.append({"id": row["id"], "action": "input", "kind"\
        : row["kind"], "version": version})
            continue
        run\
        \ = not settings["suppress_unchanged_inputs"] or built != version
    \
        \    trace.append({**row, "version": version, "action": "run" if run\
        \ else "suppressed"})
        if run:
            built = version
  \
        \  return {"trace": trace, "simulated_work_seconds": sum(r.get("duration"\
        , 0) for r in trace if r["action"] == "run")}


def order_jobs(data,\
        \ settings):
    jobs = data["jobs"]
    preferred = set(data["previous_failures"\
        ])
    while True:
        expanded = preferred | {dep for job in jobs if\
        \ job["id"] in preferred for dep in job["needs"]}
        if expanded\
        \ == preferred:
            break
        preferred = expanded
    cases\
        \ = []
    for case in data["cases"]:
        done, trace, clock, feedback\
        \ = {}, [], 0, None
        while len(done) < len(jobs):
            ready\
        \ = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in done and all(dep in done for\
        \ dep in job["needs"])]
            if not ready:
                raise\
        \ ValueError("Invalid replay dependency graph")
            if settings["\
        order"] == "previous_failure_ancestors_first":
                ready.sort(key=lambda\
        \ job: job["id"] not in preferred)
            job = ready[0]
       \
        \     skipped = any(done[dep] != "success" for dep in job["needs"])
\
        \            status = "skipped" if skipped else "failure" if job["id"\
        ] == case["failure"] else "success"
            started = clock
   \
        \         clock += 0 if skipped else job["duration"]
            if status\
        \ == "failure" and feedback is None:
                feedback = clock
\
        \            done[job["id"]] = status
            trace.append({"id"\
        : job["id"], "needs": job["needs"], "start": started, "end": clock,\
        \ "outcome": status})
        cases.append({"id": case["id"], "trace"\
        : trace, "first_failure_seconds": feedback,
                      "simulated_work_seconds"\
        : clock})
    return {"cases": cases, "simulated_work_seconds": sum(c["\
        simulated_work_seconds"] for c in cases)}


def queue_builds(data, settings):
\
        \    cases = {}
    for name, rows in data.items():
        pending, trace,\
        \ clock = list(rows), [], 0
        while pending:
            clock = max(clock,\
        \ min(row["arrival"] for row in pending))
            ready = [row for\
        \ row in pending if row["arrival"] <= clock]
            aged = [row for\
        \ row in ready if clock - row["arrival"] >= settings["max_wait"]]
  \
        \          reason = "fifo"
            if settings["order"] == "priority_with_aging"\
        :
                ready = aged if aged else ready
                reason\
        \ = "aging" if aged else "priority"
                ready.sort(key=lambda\
        \ row: (row["arrival"], rows.index(row)) if aged else
                \
        \           (-row["priority"], row["arrival"], rows.index(row)))
   \
        \         else:
                ready.sort(key=lambda row: (row["arrival"\
        ], rows.index(row)))
            row = ready[0]
            trace.append({**row,\
        \ "start": clock, "wait": clock - row["arrival"], "reason": reason})
\
        \            clock += row["duration"]
            pending.remove(row)
\
        \        cases[name] = {"trace": trace, "max_wait_seconds": max(row["\
        wait"] for row in trace),
                       "urgent_wait_seconds"\
        : next((row["wait"] for row in trace if row["id"] == "urgent"), None)}
\
        \    return {"cases": cases, "simulated_work_seconds": sum(r["duration"\
        ] for rows in data.values() for r in rows)}


def select_builds(data, settings):
\
        \    observed, trace, missed = None, [], []
    for row in data:
      \
        \  # Decision sees only the change and last executed build outcome.
    \
        \    run = not (settings["skip_docs_after_observed_success"] and row["\
        change"] == "docs" and observed == "success")
        trace.append({"\
        id": row["id"], "change": row["change"], "action": "run" if run\
        \ else "suppressed",
                      "last_observed_outcome": observed,
\
        \                      "observed_outcome": row["outcome"] if run else\
        \ None})
        if run:
            observed = row["outcome"]
     \
        \   elif row["outcome"] == "failure":
            missed.append({"id"\
        : row["id"], "cause": row.get("failure_cause")})  # Evaluator-only oracle.
\
        \    work = sum(row["duration"] for row, decision in zip(data, trace) if\
        \ decision["action"] == "run")
    return {"trace": trace, "missed_failures"\
        : len(missed), "missed_failure_details": missed,
            "missed_failure_rate"\
        : len(missed) / max(1, sum(r["outcome"] == "failure" for r in data)),
\
        \            "simulated_work_seconds": work, "simulated_saved_seconds"\
        : sum(r["duration"] for r in data) - work}


def predict_duration(data,\
        \ settings):
    history, trace = [], []
    for index, row in enumerate(data):
\
        \        pool = history
        if settings["predictor"] == "past_feature_mean"\
        :
            pool = [past for past in history if past["feature"] == row["\
        feature"]] or history
        predicted = statistics.mean(p["duration"\
        ] for p in pool) if pool else settings["initial_estimate"]
        trace.append({"\
        id": row["id"], "prediction": predicted, "actual": row["duration"\
        ],
                      "training_ids": [p["id"] for p in pool], "\
        held_out": index >= settings["train_count"]})
        history.append(row)
\
        \    held = [r for r in trace if r["held_out"]]
    return {"trace":\
        \ trace, "held_out_mae_seconds": statistics.mean(abs(r["prediction"] -\
        \ r["actual"]) for r in held),
            "simulated_work_seconds":\
        \ sum(r["duration"] for r in data), "direct_speedup_claimed": False}
\
        

def run(pattern, settings, data):
    engines = {"P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE"\
        : schedule_failures, "P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE": schedule_idle,
           \
        \    "P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST": order_jobs, "P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY": queue_builds,
\
        \               "P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT": select_builds, "P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION"\
        : predict_duration}
    return engines[pattern](data, settings)


def\
        \ validate(pattern, settings, data, result):
    """Check known scenario\
        \ controls separately from the policy implementation."""
    optimized\
        \ = settings == policy(pattern, True)
    checks = {"known_policy": optimized\
        \ or settings == policy(pattern)}
    trace = result.get("trace", [])
\
        \    if pattern == "P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE":
        actions = {r["id"]:\
        \ r["action"] for r in trace}
        checks.update(threshold_not_early=actions[0]\
        \ == actions[1] == "run",
                      threshold_pause=all(actions[i]\
        \ == ("suppressed" if optimized else "run") for i in (2, 3)),
      \
        \                notification=len(result["notifications"]) == (1 if optimized\
        \ else 0),
                      explicit_recovery=actions[4] == "owner_reset"\
        \ and actions[5] == "run",
                      success_resets_counter=all(actions[i]\
        \ == "run" for i in (6, 7, 8, 9)))
    elif pattern == "P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE"\
        :
        actions = {r["id"]: r["action"] for r in trace}
        checks.update(initial_runs=actions[0]\
        \ == "run", external_change_resumes=actions[5] == "run",
           \
        \           source_change_resumes=actions[8] == "run",
               \
        \       idle_and_generated_suppressed=all(actions[i] == ("suppressed" if\
        \ optimized else "run")
                                              \
        \         for i in (1, 3, 6, 9)))
    elif pattern == "P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST"\
        :
        checks["case_set_preserved"] = {c["id"] for c in result["\
        cases"]} == {c["id"] for c in data["cases"]}
        for case in result["\
        cases"]:
            order = {r["id"]: i for i, r in enumerate(case["\
        trace"])}
            statuses = {r["id"]: r["outcome"] for r in case["\
        trace"]}
            checks[case["id"] + "_dependencies"] = all(order[d]\
        \ < order[r["id"]] for r in case["trace"] for d in r["needs"])
   \
        \         checks[case["id"] + "_jobs_preserved"] = set(order) == {j["\
        id"] for j in data["jobs"]}
            checks[case["id"] + "_outcomes"\
        ] = statuses == ({"lint": "success", "compile": "success", "test"\
        : "failure", "package": "skipped"}
                if case["id"]\
        \ == "fails_again" else {j["id"]: "success" for j in data["jobs"]})
\
        \            checks[case["id"] + "_order"] = list(order) == (["compile"\
        , "test", "lint", "package"] if optimized else
                   \
        \                                        ["lint", "compile", "test"\
        , "package"])
    elif pattern == "P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY":
        for\
        \ name, rows in data.items():
            observed = result["cases"][name]["\
        trace"]
            checks[name + "_no_drops"] = sorted(r["id"] for\
        \ r in observed) == sorted(r["id"] for r in rows)
            checks[name\
        \ + "_valid_serial_queue"] = all(r["start"] >= r["arrival"] and
  \
        \              (i == 0 or r["start"] >= observed[i-1]["start"] + observed[i-1]["\
        duration"])
                for i, r in enumerate(observed))
        checks["\
        no_contention_control"] = [r["wait"] for r in result["cases"]["no_contention"\
        ]["trace"]] == [0, 0]
        contended = result["cases"]["contended"\
        ]["trace"]
        checks["urgent_priority"] = contended[1]["id"] ==\
        \ ("urgent" if optimized else "old")
        checks["aging_prevents_starvation"\
        ] = (any(r["reason"] == "aging" for r in contended) and
            result["\
        cases"]["contended"]["max_wait_seconds"] <= settings["max_wait"] +\
        \ 2 * max(r["duration"] for r in data["contended"])) if optimized else\
        \ True
    elif pattern == "P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT":
        checks.update(chronological_order=[r["\
        id"] for r in trace] == [r["id"] for r in data],
                    \
        \  required_changes_run=all(r["action"] == "run" for r in trace if r["\
        change"] in settings["always_build"]),
                      skipped_outcomes_hidden=all(r["\
        observed_outcome"] is None for r in trace if r["action"] == "suppressed"\
        ),
                      setup_failure_accounted=result["missed_failures"\
        ] == (1 if optimized else 0),
                      selection_occurs=any(r["\
        action"] == "suppressed" for r in trace) == optimized,
              \
        \        recovery_after_observed_failure=trace[4]["action"] == "run")
\
        \    elif pattern == "P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION":
        checks.update(no_future_training=all(all(t\
        \ < r["id"] for t in r["training_ids"]) for r in trace),
           \
        \           held_out_count=sum(r["held_out"] for r in trace) == len(data)\
        \ - settings["train_count"],
                      error_measured=result["\
        held_out_mae_seconds"] >= 0,
                      no_speedup_claim=result["\
        direct_speedup_claimed"] is False,
                      all_builds_preserved=len(trace)\
        \ == len(data))
    return checks

name: CloudTune controlled scenario
'on':
  push:
    branches:
    - ct-scenario/**
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  probe:
    name: probe
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
    - name: Controlled workload
      shell: bash
      run: "python3 - <<'CLOUDTUNE_REPLAY_ENGINE'
"""Deterministic service-policy\
        \ replays, also executed inside the hosted CI fixture.

All times and outcomes\
        \ here are synthetic. They are never repository speedups.
Only previously\
        \ observed outcomes are exposed to a scheduling/selection policy.
"""
\
        import json
import os
import statistics


PATTERNS = {
    "P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE"\
        , "P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE", "P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST",
    "P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY"\
        , "P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT", "P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION",
}


def policy(pattern,\
        \ optimized=False):
    values = {
        "P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE": {"\
        pause_after_failures": 2 if optimized else 0,
                         \
        \       "notify_on_pause": optimized, "recovery": "explicit_owner_reset"\
        },
        "P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE": {"suppress_unchanged_inputs": optimized,
\
        \                                "meaningful_inputs": ["user_source",\
        \ "external_dependency"]},
        "P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST": {"order"\
        : "previous_failure_ancestors_first" if optimized else "declared",
 \
        \                                   "cancel_other_jobs": False},
     \
        \   "P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY": {"order": "priority_with_aging" if optimized\
        \ else "fifo", "max_wait": 12},
        "P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT": {"skip_docs_after_observed_success"\
        : optimized,
                               "always_build": ["source"\
        , "lockfile", "setup"]},
        "P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION": {"predictor"\
        : "past_feature_mean" if optimized else "past_global_mean",
        \
        \                             "initial_estimate": 20, "train_count": 6},
\
        \    }
    return values[pattern]


def dataset(pattern, repeat):
  \
        \  """Three reproducible workloads; repeat changes durations, never visibility\
        \ rules."""
    if repeat not in (1, 2, 3):
        raise ValueError("\
        Replay repeat must be 1, 2 or 3")
    scale = repeat
    if pattern ==\
        \ "P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE":
        return [{"id": i, "kind": kind, "\
        outcome": outcome, "duration": 5 * scale}
                for i, (kind,\
        \ outcome) in enumerate([
                    ("scheduled", "failure"\
        ), ("scheduled", "failure"), ("scheduled", "failure"),
         \
        \           ("scheduled", "failure"), ("owner_reset", None), ("scheduled"\
        , "success"),
                    ("scheduled", "failure"), ("scheduled"\
        , "success"),
                    ("scheduled", "failure"), ("scheduled"\
        , "success")])]
    if pattern == "P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE":
        return\
        \ [{"id": i, "kind": kind, "duration": 5 * scale} for i, kind in enumerate([
\
        \            "tick", "tick", "generated_commit", "tick", "external_dependency"\
        , "tick",
            "tick", "user_source", "tick", "tick"])]
\
        \    if pattern == "P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST":
        jobs = [{"id": "\
        lint", "needs": [], "duration": 30 * scale},
                {"id"\
        : "compile", "needs": [], "duration": 10 * scale},
               \
        \ {"id": "test", "needs": ["compile"], "duration": 5 * scale},
\
        \                {"id": "package", "needs": ["test"], "duration"\
        : 3 * scale}]
        return {"previous_failures": ["test"], "jobs"\
        : jobs,
                "cases": [{"id": "fails_again", "failure"\
        : "test"},
                          {"id": "recovered", "failure"\
        : None},
                          {"id": "artifact_dependency", "failure"\
        : None}]}
    if pattern == "P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY":
        return {"\
        no_contention": [{"id": "a", "arrival": 0, "duration": 2, "priority"\
        : 1},
                                   {"id": "b", "arrival": 10,\
        \ "duration": 2, "priority": 5}],
                "contended": [{"\
        id": "blocker", "arrival": 0, "duration": 8, "priority": 0},
  \
        \                            {"id": "old", "arrival": 1, "duration"\
        : 6, "priority": 0},
                              {"id": "ordinary"\
        , "arrival": 1, "duration": 6, "priority": 0},
                   \
        \           {"id": "urgent", "arrival": 2, "duration": 1, "priority"\
        : 10},
                              *[{"id": "new-" + str(i), "arrival"\
        : 9 + i, "duration": 3, "priority": 9}
                             \
        \   for i in range(6)]]}
    if pattern == "P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT":
    \
        \    return [{"id": i, "change": change, "outcome": outcome, "duration"\
        : 5 * scale,
                 "failure_cause": "external_setup_failure"\
        \ if i == 2 else "build_failure" if outcome == "failure" else None}
\
        \                for i, (change, outcome) in enumerate([
               \
        \     ("source", "success"), ("docs", "success"), ("docs", "failure"\
        ),
                    ("lockfile", "failure"), ("docs", "success"\
        ), ("setup", "success"),
                    ("docs", "success"),\
        \ ("source", "failure")])]
    if pattern == "P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION"\
        :
        return [{"id": i, "feature": feature, "duration": duration\
        \ * scale}
                for i, (feature, duration) in enumerate([
  \
        \                  ("small", 10), ("large", 90), ("small", 12), ("\
        large", 92),
                    ("small", 11), ("large", 91), ("small"\
        , 12), ("large", 93),
                    ("small", 10), ("large",\
        \ 90)])]
    raise ValueError("Unsupported replay pattern: " + pattern)
\
        

def schedule_failures(data, settings):
    failures, paused, trace, notifications\
        \ = 0, False, [], []
    for row in data:
        if row["kind"] == "\
        owner_reset":
            failures, paused = 0, False
            trace.append({"\
        id": row["id"], "action": "owner_reset"})
            continue
 \
        \       if paused:
            trace.append({"id": row["id"], "action"\
        : "suppressed"})
            continue
        trace.append({**row, "\
        action": "run"})
        failures = failures + 1 if row["outcome"] ==\
        \ "failure" else 0
        if settings["pause_after_failures"] and failures\
        \ >= settings["pause_after_failures"]:
            paused = True
    \
        \        if settings["notify_on_pause"]:
                notifications.append({"\
        after_event": row["id"], "recipient": "synthetic_owner"})
    return\
        \ {"trace": trace, "notifications": notifications,
            "simulated_work_seconds"\
        : sum(r.get("duration", 0) for r in trace if r["action"] == "run")}
\
        

def schedule_idle(data, settings):
    version, built, trace = 0, None,\
        \ []
    for row in data:
        if row["kind"] in settings["meaningful_inputs"\
        ]:
            version += 1
        if row["kind"] != "tick":
    \
        \        trace.append({"id": row["id"], "action": "input", "kind"\
        : row["kind"], "version": version})
            continue
        run\
        \ = not settings["suppress_unchanged_inputs"] or built != version
    \
        \    trace.append({**row, "version": version, "action": "run" if run\
        \ else "suppressed"})
        if run:
            built = version
  \
        \  return {"trace": trace, "simulated_work_seconds": sum(r.get("duration"\
        , 0) for r in trace if r["action"] == "run")}


def order_jobs(data,\
        \ settings):
    jobs = data["jobs"]
    preferred = set(data["previous_failures"\
        ])
    while True:
        expanded = preferred | {dep for job in jobs if\
        \ job["id"] in preferred for dep in job["needs"]}
        if expanded\
        \ == preferred:
            break
        preferred = expanded
    cases\
        \ = []
    for case in data["cases"]:
        done, trace, clock, feedback\
        \ = {}, [], 0, None
        while len(done) < len(jobs):
            ready\
        \ = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in done and all(dep in done for\
        \ dep in job["needs"])]
            if not ready:
                raise\
        \ ValueError("Invalid replay dependency graph")
            if settings["\
        order"] == "previous_failure_ancestors_first":
                ready.sort(key=lambda\
        \ job: job["id"] not in preferred)
            job = ready[0]
       \
        \     skipped = any(done[dep] != "success" for dep in job["needs"])
\
        \            status = "skipped" if skipped else "failure" if job["id"\
        ] == case["failure"] else "success"
            started = clock
   \
        \         clock += 0 if skipped else job["duration"]
            if status\
        \ == "failure" and feedback is None:
                feedback = clock
\
        \            done[job["id"]] = status
            trace.append({"id"\
        : job["id"], "needs": job["needs"], "start": started, "end": clock,\
        \ "outcome": status})
        cases.append({"id": case["id"], "trace"\
        : trace, "first_failure_seconds": feedback,
                      "simulated_work_seconds"\
        : clock})
    return {"cases": cases, "simulated_work_seconds": sum(c["\
        simulated_work_seconds"] for c in cases)}


def queue_builds(data, settings):
\
        \    cases = {}
    for name, rows in data.items():
        pending, trace,\
        \ clock = list(rows), [], 0
        while pending:
            clock = max(clock,\
        \ min(row["arrival"] for row in pending))
            ready = [row for\
        \ row in pending if row["arrival"] <= clock]
            aged = [row for\
        \ row in ready if clock - row["arrival"] >= settings["max_wait"]]
  \
        \          reason = "fifo"
            if settings["order"] == "priority_with_aging"\
        :
                ready = aged if aged else ready
                reason\
        \ = "aging" if aged else "priority"
                ready.sort(key=lambda\
        \ row: (row["arrival"], rows.index(row)) if aged else
                \
        \           (-row["priority"], row["arrival"], rows.index(row)))
   \
        \         else:
                ready.sort(key=lambda row: (row["arrival"\
        ], rows.index(row)))
            row = ready[0]
            trace.append({**row,\
        \ "start": clock, "wait": clock - row["arrival"], "reason": reason})
\
        \            clock += row["duration"]
            pending.remove(row)
\
        \        cases[name] = {"trace": trace, "max_wait_seconds": max(row["\
        wait"] for row in trace),
                       "urgent_wait_seconds"\
        : next((row["wait"] for row in trace if row["id"] == "urgent"), None)}
\
        \    return {"cases": cases, "simulated_work_seconds": sum(r["duration"\
        ] for rows in data.values() for r in rows)}


def select_builds(data, settings):
\
        \    observed, trace, missed = None, [], []
    for row in data:
      \
        \  # Decision sees only the change and last executed build outcome.
    \
        \    run = not (settings["skip_docs_after_observed_success"] and row["\
        change"] == "docs" and observed == "success")
        trace.append({"\
        id": row["id"], "change": row["change"], "action": "run" if run\
        \ else "suppressed",
                      "last_observed_outcome": observed,
\
        \                      "observed_outcome": row["outcome"] if run else\
        \ None})
        if run:
            observed = row["outcome"]
     \
        \   elif row["outcome"] == "failure":
            missed.append({"id"\
        : row["id"], "cause": row.get("failure_cause")})  # Evaluator-only oracle.
\
        \    work = sum(row["duration"] for row, decision in zip(data, trace) if\
        \ decision["action"] == "run")
    return {"trace": trace, "missed_failures"\
        : len(missed), "missed_failure_details": missed,
            "missed_failure_rate"\
        : len(missed) / max(1, sum(r["outcome"] == "failure" for r in data)),
\
        \            "simulated_work_seconds": work, "simulated_saved_seconds"\
        : sum(r["duration"] for r in data) - work}


def predict_duration(data,\
        \ settings):
    history, trace = [], []
    for index, row in enumerate(data):
\
        \        pool = history
        if settings["predictor"] == "past_feature_mean"\
        :
            pool = [past for past in history if past["feature"] == row["\
        feature"]] or history
        predicted = statistics.mean(p["duration"\
        ] for p in pool) if pool else settings["initial_estimate"]
        trace.append({"\
        id": row["id"], "prediction": predicted, "actual": row["duration"\
        ],
                      "training_ids": [p["id"] for p in pool], "\
        held_out": index >= settings["train_count"]})
        history.append(row)
\
        \    held = [r for r in trace if r["held_out"]]
    return {"trace":\
        \ trace, "held_out_mae_seconds": statistics.mean(abs(r["prediction"] -\
        \ r["actual"]) for r in held),
            "simulated_work_seconds":\
        \ sum(r["duration"] for r in data), "direct_speedup_claimed": False}
\
        

def run(pattern, settings, data):
    engines = {"P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE"\
        : schedule_failures, "P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE": schedule_idle,
           \
        \    "P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST": order_jobs, "P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY": queue_builds,
\
        \               "P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT": select_builds, "P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION"\
        : predict_duration}
    return engines[pattern](data, settings)


def\
        \ validate(pattern, settings, data, result):
    """Check known scenario\
        \ controls separately from the policy implementation."""
    optimized\
        \ = settings == policy(pattern, True)
    checks = {"known_policy": optimized\
        \ or settings == policy(pattern)}
    trace = result.get("trace", [])
\
        \    if pattern == "P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE":
        actions = {r["id"]:\
        \ r["action"] for r in trace}
        checks.update(threshold_not_early=actions[0]\
        \ == actions[1] == "run",
                      threshold_pause=all(actions[i]\
        \ == ("suppressed" if optimized else "run") for i in (2, 3)),
      \
        \                notification=len(result["notifications"]) == (1 if optimized\
        \ else 0),
                      explicit_recovery=actions[4] == "owner_reset"\
        \ and actions[5] == "run",

name: CloudTune controlled scenario
'on':
  push:
    branches:
    - ct-scenario/**
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  probe:
    name: probe
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
    - name: Controlled workload
      shell: bash
      run: "python3 - <<'CLOUDTUNE_REPLAY_ENGINE'
"""Deterministic service-policy\
        \ replays, also executed inside the hosted CI fixture.

All times and outcomes\
        \ here are synthetic. They are never repository speedups.
Only previously\
        \ observed outcomes are exposed to a scheduling/selection policy.
"""
\
        import json
import os
import statistics


PATTERNS = {
    "P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE"\
        , "P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE", "P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST",
    "P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY"\
        , "P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT", "P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION",
}


def policy(pattern,\
        \ optimized=False):
    values = {
        "P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE": {"\
        pause_after_failures": 2 if optimized else 0,
                         \
        \       "notify_on_pause": optimized, "recovery": "explicit_owner_reset"\
        },
        "P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE": {"suppress_unchanged_inputs": optimized,
\
        \                                "meaningful_inputs": ["user_source",\
        \ "external_dependency"]},
        "P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST": {"order"\
        : "previous_failure_ancestors_first" if optimized else "declared",
 \
        \                                   "cancel_other_jobs": False},
     \
        \   "P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY": {"order": "priority_with_aging" if optimized\
        \ else "fifo", "max_wait": 12},
        "P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT": {"skip_docs_after_observed_success"\
        : optimized,
                               "always_build": ["source"\
        , "lockfile", "setup"]},
        "P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION": {"predictor"\
        : "past_feature_mean" if optimized else "past_global_mean",
        \
        \                             "initial_estimate": 20, "train_count": 6},
\
        \    }
    return values[pattern]


def dataset(pattern, repeat):
  \
        \  """Three reproducible workloads; repeat changes durations, never visibility\
        \ rules."""
    if repeat not in (1, 2, 3):
        raise ValueError("\
        Replay repeat must be 1, 2 or 3")
    scale = repeat
    if pattern ==\
        \ "P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE":
        return [{"id": i, "kind": kind, "\
        outcome": outcome, "duration": 5 * scale}
                for i, (kind,\
        \ outcome) in enumerate([
                    ("scheduled", "failure"\
        ), ("scheduled", "failure"), ("scheduled", "failure"),
         \
        \           ("scheduled", "failure"), ("owner_reset", None), ("scheduled"\
        , "success"),
                    ("scheduled", "failure"), ("scheduled"\
        , "success"),
                    ("scheduled", "failure"), ("scheduled"\
        , "success")])]
    if pattern == "P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE":
        return\
        \ [{"id": i, "kind": kind, "duration": 5 * scale} for i, kind in enumerate([
\
        \            "tick", "tick", "generated_commit", "tick", "external_dependency"\
        , "tick",
            "tick", "user_source", "tick", "tick"])]
\
        \    if pattern == "P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST":
        jobs = [{"id": "\
        lint", "needs": [], "duration": 30 * scale},
                {"id"\
        : "compile", "needs": [], "duration": 10 * scale},
               \
        \ {"id": "test", "needs": ["compile"], "duration": 5 * scale},
\
        \                {"id": "package", "needs": ["test"], "duration"\
        : 3 * scale}]
        return {"previous_failures": ["test"], "jobs"\
        : jobs,
                "cases": [{"id": "fails_again", "failure"\
        : "test"},
                          {"id": "recovered", "failure"\
        : None},
                          {"id": "artifact_dependency", "failure"\
        : None}]}
    if pattern == "P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY":
        return {"\
        no_contention": [{"id": "a", "arrival": 0, "duration": 2, "priority"\
        : 1},
                                   {"id": "b", "arrival": 10,\
        \ "duration": 2, "priority": 5}],
                "contended": [{"\
        id": "blocker", "arrival": 0, "duration": 8, "priority": 0},
  \
        \                            {"id": "old", "arrival": 1, "duration"\
        : 6, "priority": 0},
                              {"id": "ordinary"\
        , "arrival": 1, "duration": 6, "priority": 0},
                   \
        \           {"id": "urgent", "arrival": 2, "duration": 1, "priority"\
        : 10},
                              *[{"id": "new-" + str(i), "arrival"\
        : 9 + i, "duration": 3, "priority": 9}
                             \
        \   for i in range(6)]]}
    if pattern == "P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT":
    \
        \    return [{"id": i, "change": change, "outcome": outcome, "duration"\
        : 5 * scale,
                 "failure_cause": "external_setup_failure"\
        \ if i == 2 else "build_failure" if outcome == "failure" else None}
\
        \                for i, (change, outcome) in enumerate([
               \
        \     ("source", "success"), ("docs", "success"), ("docs", "failure"\
        ),
                    ("lockfile", "failure"), ("docs", "success"\
        ), ("setup", "success"),
                    ("docs", "success"),\
        \ ("source", "failure")])]
    if pattern == "P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION"\
        :
        return [{"id": i, "feature": feature, "duration": duration\
        \ * scale}
                for i, (feature, duration) in enumerate([
  \
        \                  ("small", 10), ("large", 90), ("small", 12), ("\
        large", 92),
                    ("small", 11), ("large", 91), ("small"\
        , 12), ("large", 93),
                    ("small", 10), ("large",\
        \ 90)])]
    raise ValueError("Unsupported replay pattern: " + pattern)
\
        

def schedule_failures(data, settings):
    failures, paused, trace, notifications\
        \ = 0, False, [], []
    for row in data:
        if row["kind"] == "\
        owner_reset":
            failures, paused = 0, False
            trace.append({"\
        id": row["id"], "action": "owner_reset"})
            continue
 \
        \       if paused:
            trace.append({"id": row["id"], "action"\
        : "suppressed"})
            continue
        trace.append({**row, "\
        action": "run"})
        failures = failures + 1 if row["outcome"] ==\
        \ "failure" else 0
        if settings["pause_after_failures"] and failures\
        \ >= settings["pause_after_failures"]:
            paused = True
    \
        \        if settings["notify_on_pause"]:
                notifications.append({"\
        after_event": row["id"], "recipient": "synthetic_owner"})
    return\

\
